description: This file defines the 'Code' entity class for the Fineract project, representing a code with a name, system-defined flag, and associated code values. It includes methods for creating an instance from a JSON command, updating its data, and removing code values.

classes.name: Code
classes.description: Entity class representing a system or user-defined code, with attributes such as name, systemDefined flag, and related CodeValue entities. Contains methods to instantiate from JSON, create a new code, update its fields, and remove code values.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Code instance from a JsonCommand object by extracting the 'name' parameter.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new Code instance with the specified name.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Code's name based on a JsonCommand, rejects modification if the code is system-defined.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a given CodeValue from the set of associated code values.
